name: Deore XT clamp-mounted front derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed average 136 g for FD-M785, 2×10-speed, top swing, 34.9 mm clamp-mounted assembly without S/M reducer adapters. The weight heading explicitly selects L-size band type; the mount rows distinguish the unadapted 34.9 mm band from 28.6/31.8 mm reducer configurations. Other mounts and model revisions do not inherit this weight.
